lead: A `## Next group` item's rationale about PHP behaviour is a hypothesis, not a specification, and one `php -r` settles it.
body: An item claiming "`finally` must still run on `exit`, which makes this an unwind" framed a fourth unwind kind, while `php -r 'try { exit(3); } finally { echo "f"; }'` prints nothing and exits 3, so the cheap shape — a helper whose success is a non-`OK` status — was the PHP-exact one. Priority 2 decides these and PHP is on `PATH`: run the twin *before* costing the design.
